title: potentilla sterilis
intro: Potentilla sterilis, commonly known as the sterile cinquefoil or five-finger grass, is a perennial herb in the rose family (Rosaceae) native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla sterilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms, and exhibit antispasmodic and astringent properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
